hypothesis: Control for exp-c8a-znver5: keep znver4 codegen but force sha3-asm's scalar x86_64 keccak (the backend znver5 would select) through its SHA3_ASM_SCRIPT override, isolating the keccak-backend effect from Zen 5 codegen.
llm_commentary: No-op control, as expected after the CPU-feature audit: SHA3_ASM_SCRIPT only changes sha3-asm, which reth never calls on x86_64 (keccak-asm picks its AVX-512VL Rust backend at compile time). 4.69s vs the champion's 4.67s is run-to-run noise and confirms the warm-box rebuild with an extra env var does not perturb timing. Kept as an A/A data point; the real per-CPU levers are exp-c8g-sha3-flag, exp-native-cflags and exp-native.
